adaptations: Expanded upstream Xacro to standalone URDF; mesh paths are relative to source/.
Gripper root link renamed base_link; negative mimic follower limits corrected to [-0.8, 0].
ROS UR5 link frames retained; gripper mounts at the wrist flange with a virtual TCP 0.162 m from its base.
Robotiq Collada meshes converted to OBJ in metres with baked scene transforms for portable import.
Enabled the upstream CAD finger inertias; pad inertias are estimated as uniform boxes at 1100 kg/m^3.
Fingertip collision instances are expanded so scenes can bind their contact material.
uncertainty: Virtual TCP at 162 mm; simulated mount and nominal UR5 geometry require hardware calibration.
